title: individualist vs collectivist, tradition vs progress

statements.negative: A person's own ambitions should not be sacrificed for the group.
statements.positive: When they conflict, the community's needs should come before any one person's ambitions.

statements.negative: People flourish most when they are free to pursue their own path.
statements.positive: People flourish most when they see themselves as part of a larger whole.

statements.negative: Self-reliance matters more than any safety net society could provide.
statements.positive: Society should guarantee everyone's basic welfare, even if that limits some personal freedom.

statements.negative: Big life decisions are yours alone to make.
statements.positive: Big life decisions should give real weight to what your family or community wants.

statements.negative: Long-standing customs deserve the benefit of the doubt over untested reforms.
statements.positive: We should be willing to overturn long-standing customs once they stop serving us.

statements.negative: Continuity with the past is something worth protecting.
statements.positive: Real progress usually requires breaking with the past.

statements.negative: Change should wait until it's clearly proven better than what it replaces.
statements.positive: New ways of living are worth embracing even before they're fully proven.

statements.negative: Established institutions hold hard-won wisdom that reformers often overlook.
statements.positive: Institutions should be redesigned whenever a better design comes along.

author: compass-bench v2
